## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user problem and what changes after this PR.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. State what was not exercised. For UI changes, include reviewed screenshots without pointers, identities, or customer resources.

## Rollout and recovery

Describe configuration, compatibility, migration, or recovery implications where relevant. A source merge does not deploy Azure resources.

- [ ] Relevant documentation reflects the final behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, customer configuration, or private telemetry are included.
- [ ] Tests/checks appropriate to the change pass, with limitations stated above.
